player_0.content: New plan: I failed to identify the correct option because I miscounted the vertices in the SVG path. I counted 6 points but incorrectly concluded the shape was a hexagon, while the actual shape formed by those 6 vertices is a pentagon (as the start point connects to the end point, creating 5 distinct sides). Next time, I will carefully trace the path coordinates to count the number of unique vertices and sides, ensuring that a 6-vertex closed loop is recognized as a pentagon, and then select the corresponding option (G) from the list.
